Reporter Status

Reporter Status in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings means a university has submitted data for evaluation but does not yet meet the minimum requirements—such as research output—to be fully ranked



Exclusion and inclusion criteria of THE World University Rankings 

(2025 THE World University Rankings Methodology, p. 7)

https://www.timeshighereducation.com/sites/default/files/breaking_news_files/the_2025_world_university_rankings_methodology.pdf  



THE World University Rankings 

Inclusion Criteria 

CLSU Status

There are seven key criteria for universities to be included in the Rankings:

1. They are required to publish more than 1,000 relevant (Scopus indexed) publications over the previous 5 years, and more than 100 relevant (Scopus indexed) publications in any single year. This criterion was based on the publication count including kilo-authored fractional counting until the rankings published in 2023, when we changed to the full publication count.

2020:    104

2021:     82

2022:    93
